opening.argument: The offer presents BNB staking as a way to earn a fixed 5% every day, while directing viewers to a website and Telegram chat. A BNB Harvest screen invites viewers to join, and the phone dashboard pairs “Daily ROI” and “Stake & Earn” with Deposit and Harvest controls, linking the return claim to placing BNB into the service. The speaker further urges viewers to “join us and start making money right now.” Audit-report and CertiK branding are presented alongside these claims, but their authenticity, endorsement, and scope are not established. The dashboard shows 3% rather than the separately advertised 5%, leaving the promoted terms inconsistent while still soliciting participation.
